## lib-thehive-upsert-alert (N8N-2.1, 3.1)
**Trigger:** called by playbooks through Execute Workflow, waiting for the result.
**Inputs:** `{canonical (lib-normalize-wazuh-alert), extraction (lib-extract-observables), config (lib-config), context: {playbook, n8n_execution_id}, route (lib-route-alert, optional)}`.
**Actions taken:** when lib-config says TheHive isn't deployed here (`THEHIVE_ENABLED=false`), returns `{skipped: true, reason: "TheHive not configured"}` without any call. Otherwise builds the TheHive alert (ALERT-FORMAT §1-§4; on FIM alerts, group `syscheck`, the title is `<rule.description> <syscheck.path> (<host>)` with the path cut to lib-config `title_caps.syscheck_path_max_chars` (200, "…" at the cut), X-44; observables from lib-extract-observables without their n8n-only `asox` field: caseTemplate = the route's case template, else the routing default; TheHive silently drops an unknown template or custom field, so a warning is returned when they come back empty) and creates it; sourceRef = Wazuh alert id. HTTP 400 CreateError "already exists" = already done: the existing alert is looked up by type+source+sourceRef and returned with `duplicate: true`. Each TheHive call has lib-config's timeout and is retried on a connection error, timeout or 5xx (`thehive_http.retry_waits_s`, N8N-6.2), never on 4xx; a duplicate refusal after a retried create returns `after_retry: true` (the timed-out call may have created it). Any other failure, or the last call failing, goes to lib-error (parked) and `{ok: false}` is returned. Returns `{ok, outcome, skipped}`, with the alert's `created_at` (TheHive `_createdAt`, C11's `t_alert`).
**Systems changed:** TheHive (creates one alert).
**Approval:** not needed (no system changes outside TheHive).
**Owner:** n8n.
Successful executions are not saved (N8N-6.5): the calling playbook records the result; failed ones are kept.
